about:
County Auto Salvage LLC was founded in 2020 in Claymont, Delaware. The company operates as a nationwide distributor of used OEM automotive parts, sourcing from a network of over 200 Automotive Recyclers Association (ARA) certified salvage yards across the United States and Canada.

The company supplies complete engines, transmissions, transfer cases, body panels, lighting, suspension components, electronic modules, and other recycled OEM parts. Each part undergoes multi-point inspection, compression testing, and VIN-matched fitment verification before being shipped via LTL and freight with tracking. The business employs 11 to 50 people and manages an e-commerce platform for direct distribution.

Customers include automotive repair shops, collision and auto body centers, fleet maintenance operations, commercial vehicle operators, automotive enthusiasts, DIY restorers, and insurance claim adjusters seeking cost-effective replacement parts.

County Auto Salvage emphasizes transparency by including all shipping costs in listed prices, offers a 30-day return policy, provides round-the-clock customer support, and maintains an extensive inventory spanning numerous makes and models.
